full_judgment: 2. The police started Investigating the case giving rise to G.R. Case No. 173 of 1987 of the Court of Upazila Magistrate. Narsingdi arising out of Narsingdi P.S. Case No. 8(7)87 under sections 406 and 420 of the Penal Code. The accused petitioners on being arrested were produced before the Court of the Upazila Magistrate. Narsingdi on 12.7.87 for recording their statements under section 164 Cr.P.C. The two accused petitioners were sent to Mr. Nur Hossain Talukder, Magistrate, 1st Class, for recording their confessional statements. The said learned Magistrate Mr. Nur Hossain Talukder on that very day returned the case to the Upazila Magistrate, Narsingdi observing that the two accused persons claimed themselves to be not guilty of any offence. Thereafter the Upazila Magistrate released the two accused petitioners on bail although a period of limitation of sixty days with power to the Magistrate to extend the period of investigation and to theses. Judge to direct further investigation is provided in section 176 Cr. P.C. in respect of concluding the investigation by the Police. The accused petitioners in an extra ordinary hurry without waiting for the police report moved a Division Bench of this Court and obtained Rule on 8.9.87 in the present case in which F.I.R. was admittedly lodged on 11.7.87. The Division Bench also stayed further proceedings of the present G.R. Case No. 173 of 1987 by order dated 8.9.87 for a period of six months from that date. As a result it appears that the learned Magistrate could not receive any report in respect of this case from the police. It is not known whether after investigation the police has prepared a charge-sheet of final report.
